timeline.summary: Artemis Medicare Services Limited scheduled an earnings conference call for Q4 and FY26 on May 11, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST, hosted by Anand Rathi Research with Dr. Devlina Chakravarty, Mr. Sanjiv Kumar Kothari, and Mr. Rudra Narayan Acharjee.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹279.23 Cr (+16.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹30.03 Cr (+30.4% YoY).
Artemis Medicare released its Q4FY26 and FY26 investor presentation highlighting consolidated revenue of ₹1,081.24 Cr and plans to raise ~₹700 Cr for expansion.
Artemis Medicare reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹279.23 Cr (+16.4% YoY) and PAT of ₹30.28 Cr (+32.1% YoY).
Artemis Medicare hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call, reporting strong revenue growth and detailing its 2,000-bed expansion roadmap.
Artemis Medicare board approved seeking shareholder approval via postal ballot to raise up to ₹700 Cr through issuance of securities.
Artemis Medicare Services Limited scheduled an earnings conference call for Q2 and H1 FY27 on Monday, November 2, 2026 at 11:00 AM IST.
